step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an administration workflow on the top and a user request routing workflow on the bottom. An Admin user builds container images with Docker and pushes them to Amazon ECR while using kubectl to manage the Amazon EKS cluster. EKS pulls container images from ECR. User application traffic enters through an AWS Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) layer, which forwards traffic into the Amazon EKS cluster where the NGINX Ingress Controller (KIC) inspects and performs advanced Layer 7 routing to backend microservices A, B, and C.
